item.text:
**4B.1 Research Note**

**Bottom line:** Mostly positive. In 2024 Biden publicly affirmed that elections should determine power peacefully, accepted the 2024 result, and directed a transition to Trump. The only meaningful counterevidence is weak: he publicly doubted Trump would respect a peaceful transfer if Trump lost, and Democrats’ midstream replacement of Biden on the ticket drew criticism, though legal experts said it was lawful and not a democracy violation.

| Signal | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | [Address to the Nation on the 2024 Presidential Election](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-the-nation-the-2024-presidential-election) | The American Presidency Project / White House | 2024-11-07 | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-the-nation-the-2024-presidential-election | Biden said Americans vote and choose leaders peacefully, called the transfer of power a core democratic norm, congratulated Trump on his victory, and directed his administration to cooperate on an orderly transition. This is the clearest direct evidence that he accepted contestable power through elections. | 4B.1 |
| Positive | [Biden drops out of 2024 race after disastrous debate inflamed age concerns](https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/) | Associated Press | 2024-07-21 | https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/ | Biden withdrew from the race and endorsed Harris after internal pressure, allowing the party to continue through its nomination process instead of trying to cling to the ticket. That is indirect but relevant evidence of accepting electoral contestability within constitutional rules. | 4B.1 |
| Positive | [Was Biden dropping out of the race a ‘coup’? Experts explain](https://www.politifact.com/article/2024/jul/24/was-biden-dropping-out-of-the-race-a-coup-by-democ/) | PolitiFact / AP | 2024-07-24 | https://www.politifact.com/article/2024/jul/24/was-biden-dropping-out-of-the-race-a-coup-by-democ/ | Legal experts said replacing Biden on the Democratic ticket was not unlawful and did not amount to a coup. This does not prove Biden’s personal democratic conviction, but it weakens claims that the switch was anti-democratic. | 4B.1 |
| Positive | [Biden says he's "not confident at all" there will be a peaceful transfer of power if Trump loses](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/biden-on-dropping-out-2024-race-donald-trump-cbs-sunday-morning-exclusive-interview/) | CBS News | 2024-08-11 | https://www.cbsnews.com/news/biden-on-dropping-out-2024-race-donald-trump-cbs-sunday-morning-exclusive-interview/ | Biden’s concern was that Trump might not accept losing, not that elections should be meaningless. This is still useful context: Biden framed peaceful transfer as the democratic norm and treated violations of it as a danger. | 4B.1, 4B.9 |
| Mixed / weak negative | [Biden 'not confident' of peaceful power transition if Trump loses election](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-says-he-is-not-confident-of-peaceful-transfer-of-power-after-election-3560791) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-says-he-is-not-confident-of-peaceful-transfer-of-power-after-election-3560791 | Biden publicly said he was not confident Trump would permit a peaceful transfer if he lost. That is not evidence Biden rejected contestable elections; it is evidence he thought the main threat to contestability came from Trump. | 4B.1 |
| Mixed / weak negative | [Many voters are worried about the electoral process and transition of power](https://apnorc.org/projects/many-voters-are-worried-about-the-electoral-process-and-transition-of-power/) | AP-NORC | 2024-10-28 | https://apnorc.org/projects/many-voters-are-worried-about-the-electoral-process-and-transition-of-power/ | Most voters wanted the loser to accept the outcome, and many feared post-election violence. This is not Biden-specific, but it shows the 2024 context in which his acceptance of electoral contestability mattered. | 4B.1 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Biden personally tried to void, delay, or evade electoral contestation through election denial, manipulated certification, or refusal to transfer power.
- I also did not find strong evidence that he attacked the legitimacy of elections as such; the main “negative” material is his warning that Trump might not accept defeat.
- Because the strongest material is about his own withdrawal and later acceptance of Trump’s win, confidence should be fairly high, with only a small counterweight from the broader 2024 polarization context.
